lessons.key: surviving_mutant::test ttl threshold comparisons at the exact boundary value not only just inside and just outside it so a vs mutation is caught
lessons.text: Test TTL/threshold comparisons at the exact boundary value, not only just-inside and just-outside it, so a > vs >= mutation is caught.

lessons.key: spec_precision_gap::when a hook s behavior is scoped by a static matcher config string assert the exact matcher value in a test not just the resulting command string
lessons.text: When a hook's behavior is scoped by a static matcher/config string, assert the exact matcher value in a test, not just the resulting command string.

lessons.key: spec_precision_gap::when manual verification substitutes a mock for the real external dependency the ac requires exercising disclose it explicitly and treat it as an open coverage gap not full coverage
lessons.text: When manual verification substitutes a mock for the real external dependency the AC requires exercising, disclose it explicitly and treat it as an open coverage gap, not full coverage.

lessons.key: spec_deviation::keep process spawning side effects out of pure event handlers wire them at the dispatch main level so handlers stay unit testable without mocking child process
lessons.text: Keep process-spawning side effects out of pure event handlers; wire them at the dispatch/main level so handlers stay unit-testable without mocking child_process.

lessons.key: ac_gap::when a cli test isolates home userprofile but runs the real binary against the actual reporoot any file the cli writes relative to itself e g generated config next to the script leaks into the real project on every test run isolate reporoot too not just home
lessons.text: When a CLI test isolates HOME/USERPROFILE but runs the real binary against the actual repoRoot, any file the CLI writes relative to itself (e.g. generated config next to the script) leaks into the real project on every test run - isolate repoRoot too, not just HOME.
